# ECN-2026-038 Change notice - Machining induction billet heater #1

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P1, line P1-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-IH01

Reason for change
- Background: During routine production reviews and cross-checks against process capability targets, the machining induction billet heater identified as EQ-P1-L3-IH01 demonstrated variability in billet surface condition at the machining station. This variability correlated with inconsistent billet thermal profiles entering the machining cell. The intent of this change is to stabilize the billet preheat setpoint used by EQ-P1-L3-IH01 to reduce downstream rework and improve machining tool life.
- Rationale: Analysis of production logs and metallurgical evaluations indicated that maintaining a consistent target billet temperature at the heater exit improves material ductility and dimensional stability during the machining operation. To address the root cause linked to thermal input variation, the target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01) is 1235 °C. Setting and enforcing this target at the heater control and in associated SOPs will align thermal conditioning with machining requirements and reduce process variability.

Affected items
- Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-IH01 control parameters and operator interfaces will be revised to reflect the new target billet temperature.
- Procedures: SOP-P1-L3-01 and SOP-P1-L3-02 are affected and will be updated to incorporate the new target temperature, adjusted acceptance criteria for incoming billets, and corresponding inspections to be performed by operators and quality technicians.
- Records: Production logs, heater control logs, and quality inspection records generated for billets processed through EQ-P1-L3-IH01 will be appended with a field indicating verification of the target billet temperature. Calibration records for any temperature sensing and control devices associated with EQ-P1-L3-IH01 must reference this change.
- Training: Operators assigned to the P1-L3 line and maintenance technicians responsible for EQ-P1-L3-IH01 will require briefing and competency sign-off on the revised SOPs and the operational implications of the new billet temperature target.

Implementation
- Control setpoint update: Update the heater control setpoint for EQ-P1-L3-IH01 to the specified target billet temperature. Ensure the control system displays and logs the active setpoint and the measured billet exit temperature against that setpoint. Where manual verification is included in SOP-P1-L3-01 and SOP-P1-L3-02, revise the checklists to show the required confirmation against the new target.
- Verification method: Use the existing temperature sensors and data acquisition linked to EQ-P1-L3-IH01 to verify that billet exit temperature meets the target billet temperature for each run. Calibration of sensors used for verification must be current and traceable in accordance with plant metrology practices. If the heater control operates with staged power, document how stages are adjusted to achieve the target billet temperature within process capabilities in the revised SOPs.
- Operator actions: Update SOP-P1-L3-01 to include explicit steps for confirming the heater has reached steady state at the new target before releasing billets to the machining station. Include guidance for actions to take when measured billet exit temperature deviates from the target, including hold and notify steps, and criteria for rework or reject per the updated SOPs.
- Maintenance actions: Update SOP-P1-L3-02 to reflect any required adjustments to maintenance checks that influence thermal performance. Specify inspections and acceptance criteria for heater elements, sensor mounting integrity, and insulation integrity that directly affect the ability to achieve the target billet temperature. Include instructions for logging corrective maintenance actions and documenting parts replaced or adjustments made.
- Records and traceability: Modify production log templates to include a field for target verification stating the target billet temperature and the measured value at release. Quality inspection records must capture the measurement method used and the operator or inspector initials. Equipment maintenance records must reference the change notice id and document any alterations to calibration or sensor replacement undertaken to support attainment of the target billet temperature.
- Pilot and rollout: Conduct a pilot run on the applicable shift(s) to validate that the updated target can be achieved consistently under normal production conditions. Collect process data, billet condition observations, and machining outcomes during the pilot. Based on pilot findings, finalize procedural text in SOP-P1-L3-01 and SOP-P1-L3-02 and proceed to full rollout across the P1-L3 line.

Examples and expected outcomes
- Example record entries: Production log entry should show the target billet temperature field populated with the target billet temperature and the actual measured exit temperature with an accompanying note if corrective actions were required. Maintenance logs should cite ECN-2026-038 when recording changes made to EQ-P1-L3-IH01 to support the new target.
- Expected process improvements: Stabilization of incoming billet thermal condition to the machining cell, reduction in machining rework attributed to thermal distortion, and improved predictability of tooling wear and maintenance scheduling. Quality inspections should show a reduction in surface and dimensional issues that are traceable to pre-machining billet temperature variation.

Approvals
- Approval routing: This change notice requires review and signature by production management, maintenance management, and quality engineering to confirm that SOP-P1-L3-01 and SOP-P1-L3-02 updates are complete and that the pilot validation has demonstrated acceptable performance.
- Document control: Update the controlled document list to reference ECN-2026-022, which contains the initial findings that prompted this change, and revise SOP-P1-L3-01 and SOP-P1-L3-02 to reflect the new target and associated procedures. Include cross-reference to ECN-2026-022 in the revised SOPs for traceability.
- Records to keep: Retain pilot run data, revised SOP-P1-L3-01 and SOP-P1-L3-02 revisions, operator training sign-offs, maintenance work orders related to EQ-P1-L3-IH01 calibration or repair, and production logs marked with target verification. All retained records must reference ECN-2026-038.

Related documents
- ECN-2026-022
- SOP-P1-L3-01
- SOP-P1-L3-02

End of notice.
